308-211071 DECLARATIONOFINTERESTANDNOMINEEAGREEMENT Housing Development Fund Corp., a New York not-for-profit corporation organized pursuant to Article XI of the Private Housing Finance Law of the State of New York ("Article XI") and Section 402 of the Not-for-Profit Corporation Law of the State of NewYork,having its office at c/o Community Housing Information Center, Inc.,1022 Rev. James Polite Avenue, Bronx, New York 10459 (the “HDFC") and Louis Nine-Jennings Owner LLC, a New York limited liability company having its office at c/o Best Development Group, LLC, 40 Fulton Street, New York, New York 10038 ("Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, a fee interest in the premises described in Schedule “A” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Property") was acquired by the HDFC, solely as nominee legal or record title holder on behalf of Developer, as beneficial owner of the Property, for the development thereon of a residential rental project containing one hundred twenty-three (123) rental units for individuals and families of low-income (the “Project") in accordance with Article XI; WHEREAS, a portion of the development of the Project will be financed by certain loans made or to be made to Developer (the“Loans"); WHEREAS, HDFC entered into a 421-a Affordable Housing Program Written Agreement with Developer and the City of NewYork, acting by and through its Department of Housing Preservation and Development (*"HPD") whereby 421-a Negotiable Certificates would be generated by the construction of theProject; WHEREAS, HDFC has agreed that the proceeds from the sale of 421-a Negotiable Certificates would be contributed towards the Project; WHEREAS, in addition to the Developer's obligations to the HDFC set forth in this Agreement, Developer undertakes to arrange for the sale of the 421-a Negotiable Certificates generated by the Project on behalf of the HDFC; WHEREAS, the HDFC and the Developer desire that the Developer shall market, contract and sell the 421-a Negotiable Certificates on behalf of the HDFC; the Property solely as nominee on behalf of Developer, with Developer retaining all of the equitable and beneficial ownership of the fee interest in the Property and the Project; and WHEREAS, the HDFC is authorized to acquire and hold legal or record title to the Property on behalf of and as nominee of Developer, and Developer shall possess the entire
